Francisco

DViUun
Problem Description
: DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
Troubleshooting
:
I checked the logs via AWS and what I find is that the values are are changing even while the outlet is available →
The number of occurrences is also pretty high, since last 7 days:
For me this looks like a loose wire or similar, when we have this error occuring the outlet usually stays out of order for some time and doesn't have this many occurrences and especially not during “A” state.
My recommendation is to go on site and bring a spare StateMonitor, I honestly don't believe it's a CCS issue but I can recommend also to take a spare CCS if you feel like it's necessary.
Please check all the wirings reaching the StateMonitor coming from the CCS (violet-white, orange-blue). Also try using those spare grey connectors on the EcoG.
I will send this ticket to the RC-DK queue but feel free to reach out to me if you are planning a site visit or need support.
For future reference, your case number is
0422221
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
